Hi, Fernanda. So, my plans for next quarter. My main goal is to sign one more contract with a big car maker. I am going to visit four customers in October. I am not going to wait for August this time: I am going to plan August in June, and visit customers before the summer holidays. The budget is small, so I am not going to hire anyone. Oh, you want my list of customers? No problem. I will send it to you after this call.

Next month there is a big trade show in Munich, and we are going to be there. We are going to have a stand for four days, and three people from our team are going. I am going to present the new battery adhesive on the second day. I am a little nervous, but I am looking forward to it. Fernanda, some of your customers from Brazil are going to visit the show, right? Then I will bring some brochures in Portuguese for them. And I will send you photos of the stand.
